neighbours.label: 'all' in the fixed phrase 'after all' (you are, after all, ...)
fire: She is, after all, the only surgeon in this part of the country.
We should forgive him; he was, after all, very young at the time.
Nobody should be surprised. After all, the bridge is ninety years old.
It is, after all, your money and your decision to make.
They were right to worry. The storm did arrive after all.
The prize went, after all, to the youngest player in the league.
Take a break now. After all, the report is not due until Monday.
He had, after all, promised to bring the children home by nine.
quiet: She is, by far, the only surgeon in this part of the country.
We should forgive them all; they were very young at the time.
Nobody should be surprised after the bridge was closed for repairs.
It is, in short, your money and your decision to make.
They were right to worry. All the farms were flooded by the storm.
The prize went, as usual, to the youngest player in the league.
Take a break now. All of the reports are not due until Monday.
He had, as always, promised to bring the children home by nine.

notes: ' all' x29 on the card, nearly all in 'after all'. Other uses of 'all', and 'after' alone, stay quiet.
